maria (support): Heads-up: customer (acme-ads) reporting JSON mode failures when model returns escaped unicode sequences. They get a pydantic ValidationError: `Extra fields not permitted` and also 'Expecting value' on parse for some replies. Investigating. chen (eng-ml): do we have an example response from the model and the exact API payload they used? streaming or non-streaming? maria (support): non-streaming. They pasted the raw "response" field from logs: `{\"id\":\"msg_42\",\"body\":\"It\\u2019s not working – details in 
…
\"}`. parsing fails in our schema adapter when we run jsonschema/pydantic validation. alex (sre): hmm looks like double-escaping `\\u2019` plus HTML fragments. Could be our sanitization layer incorrectly running html-escape -> JSON-encode -> JSON-decode sequence in some code paths. Has customer been on older SDK? maria (support): customer says SDK 0.12.1 (pip). They repro with direct curl too. Pasted curl they ran: ``` curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n -d '{"model":"open-qa-v1","input":"summarize","json_mode":true,"temperature":0.2}' ``` chen (eng-ml): can you reproduce with the same model + prompt? if it's returning HTML fragments inside a JSON string, our json-mode sanitizer should remove markup or at least keep it consistent. I suspect streaming chunk boundaries introduced a trailing comma that pydantic treats as invalid. Also check whether the model returned a top-level string containing another JSON blob (stringified JSON). maria (support): attaching the raw bytes from our proxy log (redacted): `{"id":"msg_42","body":"{\"summary\":\"It\u2019s failing\",\"notes\":null},` (note trailing comma) — the trailing comma is real in the bytes we stored. Parser error: `Expecting value: line 1 column 48 (char 47)`. alex (sre): OK that trailing comma indicates a chunk merge bug. @chen can we check the assembler that concatenates stream frames? maybe last frame delimiter incorrectly omitted. Also tag @jordan to update the known-issues doc and add a regression test. chen (eng-ml): adding repro steps for me to run: 1) use model open-qa-v1, set json_mode true, temperature 0.2, max_tokens 150. 2) hit same prompt, capture raw response bytes with tcpdump or proxy. 3) assert that response bytes are valid JSON before passing to adapters. I'll try to reproduce locally. jordan (devex): if this is an SDK vs direct curl difference we should document workarounds: instruct customers to set `json_mode=false` temporarily or run `json.loads(response)` in a try/except and strip trailing commas via regex as a short-term workaround. I'll prepare a small code snippet for the FAQ. support-bot: Incident INC-4201 created and assigned to eng-ml. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4201 maria (support): customer asked for ETA, told them "we're triaging, will follow up in 24h". They are blocked on a production job, high priority. chen (eng-ml): reproduced locally: when model returns stringified JSON inside body and the last stream frame contains only `,` (comma) due to our frame joiner trimming newlines, the assembled payload becomes invalid. Fix: adjust frame concatenation to preserve separators or drop trailing commas post-join. I'll open a PR to ensure assembler validates UTF-8 and runs a quick `try: json.loads(payload)` step and triggers fallback to raw-text path if invalid. alex (sre): good. Also add a canary test in eng-releases that runs the assembler against fuzzed chunk orders. maria (support): will update customer after PR and include the temporary workaround (post-process with `re.sub(r',\s*$','',payload)` before json.loads). jordan (devex): I'll add a short note to the structured-output troubleshooting doc and include the curl/snippet. chen (eng-ml): PR #2741 opened: assembler validates assembled payload and strips trailing commas only when json_mode true. rolling to canary now. maria (support): thanks team. I'll keep the ticket open and confirm with customer after canary. :thumbsup:
